$comment: Declarative classification of every official @modelcontextprotocol/conformance server scenario
for the Frihet MCP server. A rule NEVER decides a PASS: a PASS can only come from a raw SUCCESS
reported by the official harness. Rules only explain non-SUCCESS results, and each one must name
the evidence that justifies it. validate-baseline.mjs fails RED if the evidence is absent, which
is what stops a future regression from hiding behind a stale NOT_APPLICABLE.
harness-fixture       - the scenario probes a fixture of the reference 'everything' server
(a named test tool/resource/prompt). The MCP spec does not require any
server to expose it, so its absence is not a Frihet defect.
capability-absent     - Frihet does not advertise the capability, so -32601 is the spec-correct
answer. Guarded by requiresCapabilityAbsent: if Frihet ever starts
advertising it while still answering -32601, the rule stops applying and
bridge-under-test     - the scenario exercises the Streamable HTTP transport, which here is the
relay in http-bridge.mjs, not Frihet. Neither its passes nor its failures
say anything about the server. Such scenarios can never be PASS.

rules.note: Frihet advertises tools/resources/prompts only. logging/setLevel correctly returns Method not found.
